trade_construction: entry = next-bar-open after the breaking touch ENDS (break confirmed, no look-ahead); side = breakout direction; risk R = 0.6x ATR(14) at zone creation; stop = entry -/+ R; target = entry +/- R-multiple x R; race-to-target-or-stop, max 200 bars, same-bar ambiguity scored as the stop
